'''Wraith Leader''' was the leader of [[Wraith Squadron (Empire)|Wraith Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was ambushed by the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' sometime before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Date" /> During this attack, Wraith Leader was killed alongside the rest of the squadron.<ref name="Shadow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wraith Leader was first mentioned in the "Rogue Shadow" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', which was released on [[October 26]], [[2010]].
